description: This file contains multiple Orleans grain implementations focused on testing persistent state storage. It includes grains with different key types and generic grain implementations, each exposing methods for reading, writing, and deleting state, as well as retrieving state metadata.

classes.name: GrainStorageTestGrain
classes.description: A grain that tests persistent state with a simple integer field, providing methods to get, set, and delete the stored value.

classes.name: GrainStorageTestGrainExtendedKey
classes.description: A grain that tests persistent state with extended key capabilities, including retrieving the primary key as a string.

classes.name: GrainStorageGenericGrain<T>
classes.description: A generic grain implementation for testing persistent state with a generic type parameter, supporting common CRUD operations.

methods.name: GetValue
methods.description: Returns the current value of Field1 from the persistent state.

methods.name: DoWrite
methods.description: Writes a value to Field1 in the persistent state and persists the change.

methods.name: DoRead
methods.description: Reads the current state from the store asynchronously and returns Field1.

methods.name: GetStateAsync
methods.description: Retrieves the current state metadata, including whether a record exists and the ETag.

methods.name: GetExtendedKeyValue
methods.description: Returns the primary key as a string.
